what: The file tree of folders, notebooks, files and Git folders (repos).

sdk.code:
from databricks.sdk import WorkspaceClient
w = WorkspaceClient()
w.workspace.mkdirs("/Shared/course")
w.repos.create(url="https://github.com/user/demo.git", provider="gitHub", path="/Repos/me@example.com/demo")

notes: Git folders: POST /api/2.0/repos with {url, provider, path}. Notebooks: databricks_notebook / w.workspace.upload or import_ (POST /api/2.0/workspace/import).

what: Unity Catalog explorer: catalogs, schemas, tables, volumes and grants.

terraform.resource: databricks_catalog, databricks_schema, databricks_volume, databricks_sql_table, databricks_grants (or databricks_grant)

sdk.call: w.catalogs.create(name); w.schemas.create(name, catalog_name); w.volumes.create(catalog_name, schema_name, name, volume_type); w.grants.update(securable_type, full_name, changes=[PermissionsChange(...)])
sdk.code:
w.catalogs.create(name="course")
w.schemas.create(name="bronze", catalog_name="course")
from databricks.sdk.service.catalog import VolumeType
w.volumes.create(catalog_name="course", schema_name="bronze", name="raw", volume_type=VolumeType.MANAGED)

notes: Schemas POST /api/2.1/unity-catalog/schemas; volumes POST /api/2.1/unity-catalog/volumes; grants PATCH /api/2.1/unity-catalog/permissions/{securable_type}/{full_name}. Prefer databricks_grants (authoritative per securable) or databricks_grant (additive).

what: Lakeflow Jobs (scheduled multi-task workflows) and Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines.

sdk.call: w.jobs.create(name=, tasks=[Task(...)]); w.pipelines.create(name=, catalog=, schema=, libraries=[...])
sdk.code:
from databricks.sdk.service import jobs
w.jobs.create(name="daily", tasks=[jobs.Task(task_key="a",
    notebook_task=jobs.NotebookTask(notebook_path="/Shared/course/etl"))])

notes: Pipelines: POST /api/2.0/pipelines. Job example omits compute (serverless) - UNCONFIRMED that the minimal HCL applies in every workspace; docs example uses new_cluster.

what: Classic clusters; serverless compute needs no object, its Python environments are workspace base environments.

sdk.code:
w.clusters.create(spark_version="17.3.x-scala2.13", cluster_name="shared",
    node_type_id="i3.xlarge", num_workers=1, autotermination_minutes=20)
# serverless environments:
list(w.environments.list_workspace_base_environments())

notes: Serverless has no resource of its own. Base environments: POST /api/environments/v1/workspace-base-environments (docs: /api/workspace/environments). SDK example values (runtime version, node type) are illustrative. Environments SDK doc URL: workspace/environments/environments.html.

notes: The Discover page itself is a UI view; only its domains are objects. Domain tag_key must be an existing governed tag. SDK Domain field names not individually checked beyond tag_key/subtitle (from TF docs).
